title: How to Hire a Voice-Over Artist on Fiverr: Prices and Checks
h1: How to hire a voice-over artist on Fiverr
description: How to find and book a voice-over artist on Fiverr: what our picks charge, how pricing by word count and usage works, auditions, and what to send.
intro: Fiverr has a large pool of voice-over artists, from beginners with a USB microphone to professionals with treated studios and broadcast credits. Booking the right one comes down to listening carefully, understanding how pricing works and sending a clear script. This article walks through the process and shows what the voice actors we feature charged when we last checked.

faq.q: Why do voice-over prices depend on word count?
faq.a: Recording, editing and checking take longer for longer scripts, so most artists price by words or minutes of finished audio.
They define where you may use the recording. Personal or internal use is usually included; paid ads, TV or radio often cost extra.

faq.q: Can I ask for an audition first?
faq.a: Many artists will record a short sample of your script for a real project. Send two or three lines, not the whole script.

faq.q: What file should I ask for?
faq.a: A WAV file is common for editing; an MP3 is fine for quick use. Ask whether the audio is cleaned and edited, or raw.
Usually a fix to the artist's delivery, such as a mispronounced word. Changing the script after recording is normally a new order or a paid revision.
